caption: Recorded by soroban-sim’s native run of the simulation page. OpenZeppelin requests carried 2 authorization entries, Perch requests 1. The window is the Perch grant’s record, or `spending_limit`’s history (none while it is removed). Every refusal was an enforcing simulation that left the ledger unchanged. Payments go to the shop unless noted. The window column is the stored record; spends 100 or more ledgers old leave it at the next charge.
